program: Biomedical Data Science PhD (Stanford Biosciences home program)

requirements.quote: All of our degree programs have the same prerequisites. Note that these are the minimum requirements, and that many applicants exceed them. Calculus: at least one year, preferrably the track taught for engineering or physical science.
Additional coursework in multivariate calculus is strongly recommended
Probability and statistics: at least one course
requirements.note: Claude: one course in probability OR statistics; an intro statistical inference course satisfies it

requirements.quote: preferably one course in both areas
Linear algebra Computer science: one year, preferably the introductory sequence for CS majors.
requirements.note: Claude: 'Computer science: one year' is a coursework requirement; programming skills alone do not establish it

requirements.quote: we do require that students have strong undergraduate preparation in computer science/software engineering, mathematics (especially calculus, probability and statistics, and linear algebra), and college-level biology.

problems: The prerequisites are a bulleted list under 'Prerequisites for Graduate Degrees in Biomedical Data Science' (same for all DBDS degrees, described as minimum requirements); list items are quoted as they appear in page text (items separated only by whitespace). 'preferably one course in both areas' qualifies the probability-and-statistics item (one course in probability AND one in statistics preferred).
The computer science item ('one year ... fundamentals of computer science (data structures and algorithms) and software engineering principles') is mapped to programming.
Stanford Biosciences How-to-Apply confirms Biomedical Data Science is one of four home programs with course background requirements; GRE Subject Test (Mathematics or Physics) optional for BDS.
Overview page: 'Applicants with limited backgrounds in these areas should fill the deficiencies prior to applying to our program.'
